limits: All and only the four declared input files were read as research inputs. Source references and links were not followed; no browsing, peer outputs, identity packets, accepted product answers or other repository files were accessed.
No exact product identity was recognized or searched for. Isolation was contractual rather than a technical sandbox.

The first combined tool display truncated part of the lexicon; the same allowed lexicon was reread as complete canonical-name, roles and notes entries before estimation. No input-access expansion occurred.
All four complete-formula binary outputs are provisional estimates with low confidence; they are not sensory validation, measured repeated accumulation or human approval.

All 84 primary ranks are covered exactly once, with literal raw/canonical names and roles copied from the inputs. Explicitly unassessed functions remain unresolved. The C03 formula code is retained separately as context.
Rank is qualitative order only. No material amounts, quantity boundaries, product identities, marketing claims, user-fit properties or additional product properties were inferred.

The only consumed accepted material prior is exact whole jojoba at C03 rank 3, reference oil-natural-build-up-v0.1 version 0.1, OE51 and HW001. It is used solely as a constituent clue; the other material tendencies remain unassessed.

The frozen v0.3 method requires an opposite binary alternative even when earlier material-reference language mentions unknown. Complete-formula uncertainty therefore remains in the named assumptions, counter-signals and unresolved gaps.

Nonsemantic verification checks JSON serialization, required schema keys and types, complete neutral-ID and rank coverage, exact copied names/roles, valid evidence references, opposite binary alternatives and exact allowed-input SHA256 values. It does not validate the scientific judgments.
